name: Short Cut Guacamole Chopped Salad with Black Beans, Tomatoes, Cheese & Tortilla Squares

instructions.primary_message: Place the contents of each salad kit in a medium bowl (reserving dressing and topping packets).
instructions.secondary_message: 2 (11.25 oz) pkg guacamole crunch chopped salad kit

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and halve tomatoes. Drain and rinse beans. Add both to the bowl with the salad along with the cheese, dressing, and guacamole. Toss to combine the salad, seasoning with salt and pepper to taste.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ (12 oz) pkg cherry tomatoes
1 (15 oz) can black beans
⅔ cup shredded cheese, Mexican blend

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls and top with tortilla squares. Enjoy!
